goal: Play the first 10 minutes as a brand-new player who has never seen the game; note every moment of confusion. Also check specifically: after you found a settlement and enter it, does the 'Build a market stall' objective complete only when YOU build a stall, or do residents build stalls in your own settlement first (they should not)?

findings.title: 'Eat something' objective completes by itself almost instantly, before the player can read it
findings.detail: Objective 2 'Eat something' appeared at tick 951 and completed at tick 1003 (52 ticks) while I pressed nothing; energy was ~96, no visible eating feedback, food counts did not visibly drop. The catalog says you eat automatically when energy runs low, but the objective flashed past at near-full energy, so a new player never learns how eating works. Expected: either a visible 'You ate an apple' moment or an objective that waits for a real meal.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --seed 101; Start; Begin; pt walkto tree; e (x2 trees until Wood 10/10); pt wait 4; pt events 10

findings.title: Found-settlement refusal says 'open ground lies ~81 to the north' but the HUD has no compass
findings.detail: Pressing F too close to another camp gives a helpful message with a compass direction, but nothing on screen shows which way north is. I had to infer it (north = +Z). Expected a compass / heading indicator, or a marker for the suggested site.
findings.repro: ...gather 50 wood near spawn; pt key f (at ~(-43,132))

findings.title: Finding a legal settlement site is a chase: NPC nations keep claiming ground ahead of you
findings.detail: With 53 wood I was refused three times (Newburg 175 away, Yellowfield 98 away, Village of Yellowfield 139 away) as NPC nations founded settlements around me; the 250-unit spacing meant walking ~350 units north. Found-settlement objective took 2800 ticks, the longest of the arc. Messages were clear, but the treadmill felt frustrating in the first 10 minutes.
findings.repro: seed 101; create nation (N); gather 50 wood around spawn; F repeatedly while heading where the message says

findings.title: Tutorial tips arrive out of step with objectives
findings.detail: Tips 1-2 (walk/look) were never visibly on screen; the first tip I saw was 'Tip 3 of 5: Gather stone' while objective 1 was still Gather wood. 'Tip 5 of 5: Your goals' (explains the top-left goals panel) appeared only after I had founded my settlement, i.e. after four objectives were done. Expected tips to match the current objective and the goals tip to come first.
findings.repro: seed 101; Start; Begin; pt walkto tree; e; screenshot

findings.title: Huge settlement billboard ('0 here, 0/8 residents') covers the top HUD and disagrees with the panel
findings.detail: At/inside my own settlement a giant floating label spans the top of the screen behind the chronicle and toasts, half-hidden. Right after founding it read '0/8 residents' while Settlement Info said Residents 2/8 (later '1 here, 2/8 residents').
findings.repro: found a settlement; stand at its well; screenshot

findings.title: Objective 7 progress bar text clipped: 'nbers 2/10 - Buildings 0/2'
findings.detail: The 'Reach the Village era' progress bar label is cut on the left, losing 'Mem' of 'Members'. Also the body says 'Village 0/1... 2 buildings' while the bar asks for 10 members, which is confusing.
findings.repro: complete objective 6 (build stall); look at the top-left objective panel

findings.title: Inside a settlement the Inventory panel jumps to screen centre; own resident labelled 'Stranger'
findings.detail: Once inside with a resident nearby, Inventory Info moved from the left column to the middle of the view, covering the scene. The action button reads 'Talk to Ruth Walker (Stranger)' although she is a member of my nation.
findings.repro: found settlement; let a resident join; H; e; screenshot

findings.title: Probe state.json objective.progress lags the on-screen value
findings.detail: state.json said 'Wood 0/10' while the HUD showed 5/10, and 'Wood 3/20 - Stone 0/5' after I already had 5 stone. Not player-facing, but misleads tooling.
findings.repro: chop one tree; compare pt state with screenshot

findings.title: Very low fps/tps on the shared machine (fps 0-2, tps 3-10)
findings.detail: Game time ran ~5-10x slower than real time; clicks/screens took several seconds to show (the first Start click looked ignored, '? Controls' took >3 s to open). Probably caused by parallel sessions, but worth watching.

verdict: The goal check passes: in my own settlement the 'Build a market stall' objective stayed open for ~1950 ticks with a resident present and 0/4 stalls, and completed only when I pressed B myself. The first-arc objectives and refusal messages are clear and well rewarded, but the onboarding stumbles: tips arrive out of order, 'Eat something' completes before it can be read, and finding a legal settlement site (no compass, NPC nations claiming ground ahead of you) is the frustrating stretch of the first ten minutes.
